name: Authorized user can successfully log out
description:
Precondition: A new test user is created via API, user is authorized.
UI: User clicks the Logout button on the Profile page.
Verification: User is redirected to the Login page, check that the 'token'
cookie is cleared/empty. Re-open Profile page directly via URL. Verify that
application shows unauthenticated state (warning message with Login and Register links).
Verify that the 'token' cookie remains empty and session was not restored.

steps.name: API: Create a test user qa_user_eb09b590
API: Send create user request
API: Generate an access token with full details (token + expires) for qa_user_eb09b590
API: Send generate token request
UI: Set authentication cookies (userID, token, userName) for user 879178da-3e77-4712-a19e-fe4a7ec1b663
$("open") https://demoqa.com/favicon.ico
$("webdriver") create()
Open profile page
Open page https://demoqa.com/profile
$("open") https://demoqa.com/profile
Verify that profile page is opened
$("webdriver") should have url containing https://demoqa.com/profile
Verify that user name qa_user_eb09b590 is displayed on profile page
$("#userName-value") should have(exact text "qa_user_eb09b590" (because User name should match the one used for login))
Verify that Logout button is visible
$("By.xpath: //button[text()='Logout']") should be(visible (because Logout button should be visible after successful login))
Click on Logout button and redirect to Login page
$("By.xpath: //button[text()='Logout']") click()
Verify that login page is opened
$("webdriver") should have url containing https://demoqa.com/login
Verify that Login button is visible (unauthorized state)
$("button[id='login']") should be(visible (because Login button should be visible for unauthorized user))
UI: get the authorization token from the browser cookie
Open profile page
Open page https://demoqa.com/profile
$("open") https://demoqa.com/profile
Verify that profile page is opened
$("webdriver") should have url containing https://demoqa.com/profile
Verify unauthorized user message and links on Profile page
$("#notLoggin-wrapper") should be(visible (because Unauthorized warning wrapper should be displayed on /profile))
$("#notLoggin-label") should have(text "Currently you are not logged into the Book Store application" (because Text informing that user is not logged in should be visible))
$("#notLoggin-label a[href='/login']") should be(visible (because Link to Login page should be displayed inside warning text))
$("#notLoggin-label a[href='/register']") should be(visible (because Link to Register page should be displayed inside warning text))
UI: get the authorization token from the browser cookie
